items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: Aren't some of your old friends from the Bob Crosby days back together again

ctx.x: Thank you. Bye. Bye. 522-3791. We have about five minutes left. And Eddie Miller and Pete Fountner with us tonight. Hello. Go ahead, please.
I'd like to ask Mr. Miller a question. Aren't some of your old friends from the Bob Crosby days back together again, and don't they have a band playing somewhere in New York?
Yes, they do. They call themselves Bob Haggart, Yank Lawson, greatest, world's greatest jazz band.
